title: Kernel discipline: key_export_private outlen not validated against allocation size
description: In ioctl_key_export_private(), key_export_private() is called with bufsz=CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN but the returned outlen is stored directly into state->outbuf_len without checking outlen <= CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN. A provider that returns outlen > CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN sets outbuf_len > outbuf_cap. Subsequent read() computes to_copy = min(user_count, outbuf_len - outbuf_drained) and calls copy_to_user(outbuf + outbuf_drained, to_copy), reading past the end of the outbuf allocation. Fix: add if (outlen > CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_IMPORT_MAXLEN) check before storing into state->outbuf_len, with appropriate cleanup and error return.
